description: Find and replace text in a file on the device. Uses sed internally with proper escaping — exposes a safe interface without requiring sed syntax knowledge. Supports global replacement, line-targeted edits, and optional backup creation. Reports match count.

find.description: Text to find (literal string, not regex)

global.description: Replace all occurrences (default: true). Set false for first-only.

lineNumber.description: Restrict replacement to a specific line number

root.description: Use root shell for protected paths

name: adb_file_replace
